items.title: Single-condition neural solvers encode transferable response spaces for parametric differential equations
items.excerpt: LST reuses the output-Jacobian response space of a neural solver trained at one condition to adapt across parametric PDE conditions; ATM adds response spaces when residuals indicate poor coverage. Across six systems, the authors report lower error/offline cost than evaluated physics-informed operator baselines and millisecond-to-second target adaptation.

items.title: Backward SDEs-based Diffusion for Physics-Constrained Generation
items.excerpt: The paper proposes terminal-conditioned inversion for frozen score-based diffusion priors using a backward SDE, enforcing a task-defined terminal feasibility condition without retraining the score model. A neural BSDE solver is demonstrated on sparse-view CT with strict measurement feasibility.
